findings.text: follow-on: the required reason is a type annotation, not a runtime guard, so host.stop(None) would still write stop_reason: null -- the negative control itself reaches that state. Every current call site and stop path is covered by the new tests, so this is a residual rather than a defect; raising on a non-str, or asserting reason in stop(), would close it without a second default.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified 2 production call site(s) of SessionHost.stop (session_host.py:581, session_host.py:622), both passing a reason; no other caller exists.
item_verdicts.diff: read revision by revision (5eaaf28fa fix + tests, 242220970 evidence fragment) against base d7d80fbd6.
item_verdicts.done_when: read §13's done-when; tests/test_session_host.py drives a bare request_stop() (test_a_bare_stop_request_records_a_reason) and an end-of-file on a plain pipe (test_an_end_of_file_records_a_reason), both assert a non-null stop_reason, and the manifest's gate logs 24 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: read the plan section a-follower-lives-as-long-as-its-session §13 and the node brief; the landed diff makes stop's reason required, records the end-of-file reason, keeps the signalled fallback, and names the entry finally.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states baseline 22 / after 24 both EXIT=0, the negative control 2 failed EXIT=1, and the two landed revisions.

justifications.durability: Each new test fails with stop_reason: None when the reason its path records is removed, so the guard fires rather than passing vacuously; the required-argument signature stops a call site that omits the reason from being written.
justifications.evidence: I reproduced the reviewed run's own negative control on a scratch copy of head 242220970: removing the end-of-file reason and the signalled fallback turns both new tests red with stop_reason: None (2 failed, 14 deselected, EXIT=1); the two new tests pass at head (2 passed, EXIT=0). baseline.log 22 passed EXIT=0 and gate.log 24 passed EXIT=0 match the manifest's arms.
justifications.fit: the two new constants (_REQUEST_ENDED_REASON, _EXITED_REASON) sit beside the existing _OWNER_ENDED_REASON/_SIGNALLED_REASON and the comments describe the mechanism, not a plan or ticket.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/session_host.py:465 makes stop(reason: str) required; the end-of-file branch at session_host.py:566 sets reason = _REQUEST_ENDED_REASON, the supervise finally at session_host.py:581 falls back to _SIGNALLED_REASON, and run()'s finally at session_host.py:622 passes _EXITED_REASON, so every stop path names a reason.
justifications.reuse: the change reuses the existing stop()/_write_record stop_reason machinery and the constant convention; no second stop path or new abstraction is introduced.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat d7d80fbd6..242220970 changes only the three declared write paths (reckon/crew/session_host.py, tests/test_session_host.py, the evidence fragment); no path outside the brief's scope is touched.
